ai_summary: A2Z Infra Engineering's Board has approved the re-appointment of Mr. Amit Mittal as Managing Director cum CEO for three years, and M/s. MRKS & Associates as statutory auditors for a second five-year term, both contingent on shareholder approval. These decisions indicate continuity in both executive leadership and external oversight, maintaining the current strategic direction and auditing partnership. However, potential governance considerations include the CEO's spouse serving as a Non-Independent Director and the extended tenure of the same statutory auditors, which may warrant scrutiny regarding board independence and audit rotation best practices.
